ns2:course.label: Senior Research
ns2:course.description: (ACCY 299) Research and readings course for students majoring in accountancy. May be taken by students in the college honors program in partial fulfillment of the honors requirements. May be repeated to a maximum of 6 hours. 2 to 4 undergraduate hours. Prerequisite: Cumulative grade-point average of 3.0., honors in the junior year, or consent of department; senior standing.
